old_problem: The OCP case duplicates a generic PCIe BDF pair and lacks module/interface identity, independent-management analysis, a disposable poison consumer, decoded AER policy and service-recovery criterion.
disposition_reason: Poisoned-TLP non-fatal handling is technically definable, while OCP slot/BDF/interface/service bindings and the bounded traffic flow are project inputs allowed by ED-23. ED-02/04/19 require this record to retain its OCP module and service identity rather than collapse into row57. Proprietary errortype6 is execution-gated by the signed AMD package, so no command value is guessed and no Pending decision remains.
decision_basis: Read exact Reliability row58, its DeepSeek/GPT history, PCIe companion row57 and next pending fatal row59.
Retained every OCP module plus separate endpoint and upstream-port poison paths.
Added interface, management, storage/fabric dependency and disposable-traffic evidence unique to OCP coverage.
Bound PASS to exact non-fatal AER attribution and restored service, not tool PASS or generic logs.
No DUT traffic, BIOS/HDT change, injection, reset or recovery action occurred.

test_case.test_name: OCP Poisoned-TLP non-fatal containment with service continuity
test_case.purpose: For each required OCP module, verify endpoint and upstream-port Poisoned-TLP handling against isolated disposable traffic, with correct non-fatal AER attribution and recovered link, interface and dependent services.
required_package: Disposable traffic transaction, timeout and OCP recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: Select one signed OCP path whose critical traffic is isolated; baseline its AER, link, interface and services and start the approved disposable transaction; using only the vendor recipe inject errortype6 at the verified endpoint, then after full cleanup at its upstream port; correlate Poisoned-TLP source/status/severity and traffic outcome; restore all changed state and verify service health before another module.
test_case.expected_result: Each intended OCP source records the approved uncorrectable non-fatal Poisoned-TLP event within timeout; disposable traffic follows the signed outcome; no fatal/DPC/SyncFlood/host reset or unintended management loss occurs; link, driver, interface and services recover to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS needs module identity, both source transcripts, exact AER source/severity, bounded traffic outcome, no fatal escalation, full OCP service health and restoration. A copied BDF, unconsumed poison, generic log, wrong source, critical-traffic impact, reset or persistent degradation fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated/quiesced OCP path with management independent of the tested interface.
Never poison production, storage, cluster-control or management transactions.
One verified module, source and disposable flow at a time; abort on wrong source, fatal escalation, reset, link/interface/service loss or storm.
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and use approved OCP recovery.
expected_evidence: Approved package plus decoded AER policy
Endpoint and upstream-port Poisoned-TLP AER records
Link/interface/service recovery with no fatal reset
test_case.recovery: Stop traffic and injection, retain AER and service evidence, restore the saved AER/severity/SyncFlood/HDT/BIOS state, recover the interface/device only through the OCP runbook using independent OOB, and verify dependent services before release; do not auto-retry.
